name: Pursed-Lip Breathing

instructions.description: Sit upright or stand comfortably with shoulders relaxed.
Inhale slowly through the nose for a gentle comfortable breath.
Exhale through lightly pursed lips for longer than the inhale as if softly blowing out a candle.
Continue for several relaxed breath cycles.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use especially during recovery after exertion if helpful.
Aim for a longer exhale than inhale.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Combine abdominal expansion with pursed-lip exhalation.

commentsNotes: Keep the jaw and neck relaxed.
